events.name: Special
events.custom_event_name: [SCREEN FADES IN, REVEALING THE PARENTS’ BEDROOM WITH WILLIAM’S SPRITE ON SCREEN]

segments.text: William mumbled as he carefully stepped into the room before he caught himself and stopped his tracks.
Ah, right… They’re no longer here, are they?

Instead of looking around the room, he just froze there, taking the sight of his parents’ room from the carpet below his foot up to the ceiling. William realizes, with a sharp stab right into his heart, that his parents never even allowed him to step inside this very room, not until now, when they’re no longer breathing the damp air he’s breathing.
Mother, Father, I promise I don’t mess with your things too much.

events.custom_event_name: [WILLIAM’S SPRITE FADES OUT WHILE THE BACKGROUND FADES INTO BLANKNESS FOR THE FLASHBACK]
